issues.description: Method name inconsistency for the animal feeding sound: the UML in the problem statement and the reference implementation declare an abstract method named messageOnFeed(), while several explanatory paragraphs and task descriptions in the problem statement refer to the same behavior as getFeedingSound(). Specifically, the UML block in problem_statement.md defines {abstract} messageOnFeed(), the Seal/Pig/Goat tasks and the feedAllAnimals description in the problem statement mention getFeedingSound(), and the solution code declares public abstract String messageOnFeed() and calls animal.messageOnFeed(). This naming mismatch can confuse students about which method to implement and which name the tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all materials. Preferred fix: update the problem statement paragraphs and tasks that mention getFeedingSound() to use messageOnFeed(), and clarify that feedAllAnimals() calls messageOnFeed() on each Animal. Alternatively (less preferred), rename the abstract method in the UML and solution to getFeedingSound() and update code/tests accordingly. Ensure all examples, template comments, and tests reference the same identifier so students know which method to implement.
